summary.text: Bernie Perryman is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Aric Putnam (D).
She currently represents District 14A in the Minnesota House of Representatives and is not running for re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Perryman earned a bachelor's degree from Quincy College and is a business owner.
She assumed office in the Minnesota House on January 3, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session Perryman was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy Committee, where she was co-vice chair, and the Health Finance and Policy Committee.
